mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO focuses on optimizing websites for search engine algorithms through keywords, backlinks, and technical aspects. GEO builds upon this by incorporating generative AI. It not only optimizes for search engines but also for how AI models process and synthesize information to answer user queries. GEO involves creating content that is comprehensive enough for AI to understand, summarize, and present accurately, moving beyond just ranking to being directly integrated into AI-generated responses. It emphasizes content quality and relevance for both human and AI consumption.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO optimizes content for both traditional search engines and generative AI platforms, aiming for AI integration in responses, while traditional SEO focuses primarily on search engine rankings.
